title: Grateful Dead Live at Winterland Arena on 1970-04-15
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > CD > EAC > mkwACT > SHN

ai_review.summary: A near‑perfect soundboard capture of a 1970 Spring show highlighted by an explosive Other One/cryptical jam and superb band chemistry.
ai_review.review: The recording is crystal‑clear, sounding like you’re sitting in the first row at Winterland.  Musically the night is unforgettable – the cryptical‑drums‑jam segue into a monster The Other One, plus blazing performances of Lovelight, Candyman, Man’s World and Dancin’ make it a benchmark Spring‑70 show.  Even with a few missing tracks the energy and tightness keep the listening experience pure fire.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 60 reviews, virtually all five‑star, praise both performance (70 % weight) and sound quality (30 % weight).  The show is repeatedly called “essential” and the recording described as “crisp”, “clear” and “soundboard”.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers note crisp, clear mix with perfect vocal balance; no significant distortion or drop‑outs mentioned.  A few comments about missing songs/cuts but those are set‑list issues, not audio fidelity.

standout_songs: Cryptical Envelopment → Drums → Jam → The Other One
show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is praised for seamless segues – especially the cryptical‑drums jam into The Other One and the Lovelight/NFA sandwich – creating a powerful arc that builds from tight early songs to soaring improvisations.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Repeatedly called “smoking”, “perfect tone”, “deliberate and creative” – his guitar work is a highlight throughout.
band_member_comments.Phil: Described as “groovin’” and providing the thundering bass foundation for The Other One, though no detailed solo comments.
band_member_comments.Bob: Few direct mentions; overall band cohesion praised, implying solid rhythm‑guitar support.
band_member_comments.Keys: Positive notes on keyboards (Keith/Brent) adding texture; one reviewer calls Brent a “burn out” but the majority appreciate the keyboard layers.
band_member_comments.Drums: The cryptical drum passages are called “scorching”, “intense”, and “the best drums I’ve heard”; percussion jam is singled out as a highlight.
